mentions.name: Everything feed reader
mentions.description: A pluggable "everything" feed reader framework that pushes arbitrary content sources — email, Slack notifications, RSS, and more — into an RSS-feed-reader-style interface. It aims to provide one place to manage all notification settings, e.g. surfacing Slack messages containing a chosen keyword. Planned features include summarization and tagging using a local small language model that can run on older hardware.
mentions.problem: Notifications are scattered across email, Slack, RSS and other channels with no single place to manage notification settings.
mentions.audience: Personal use — the author managing their own notifications
mentions.source_excerpt: An “everything” feed reader. Its a plugable framework that allows you to push anything into an RSS feed reader type interface. Email, Slack notifications, RSS, etc.
